title.zh: 历史各向同性压力磁通 Picard 平衡

summary: Solve bounded axisymmetric isotropic pressure-current feedback with both a flux-update and a terminal current-closure residual, then serialize the final pressure spline.

identity.relation: midplane radial pressure, vacuum flux and cell-current Green response to an isotropic pressure-driven flux state
identity.direction: R-Z grid, P(R), vacuum flux, Green matrix and Picard controls -> flux, cell currents, P(psi) representation and convergence diagnostics
identity.definition: Delegate feedback to the maintained compute_equilibrium implementation. At each bounded update build the outward midplane pressure spline, evaluate I_target=R*dP/dpsi*abs(dR*dZ), relax current, contract the supplied Green matrix, rebuild the terminal spline and check both ||psi_new-psi_old||_2/abs(psi_edge_new) and ||I_new-I_target(psi_new)||_2/||I_target(psi_new)||_2. A zero target and zero error give zero closure residual; a zero target with nonzero current fails. Converged requires both finite residuals <=tol after an actual update. The adapter owns no second iteration loop and returns an exactly reconstructible pressure prefix.
identity.model: Axisymmetric isotropic pressure-only discrete closure using the shared bounded dual-residual solver
identity.geometry: uniform rectilinear cylindrical R-Z grid with one complete exact Z=0 row
identity.coordinates: [Z,R] arrays and C-order field-cell/field-point Green-matrix row and column order
identity.boundary: The first exact zero in the radial midplane pressure samples defines the pressure edge; the pressure spline extrapolates to zero outside its sampled flux interval.
assumptions: The caller supplies a physically appropriate vacuum psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad and a dense cell-current Green matrix in Wb/rad/A; the pressure derivative is taken with respect to the same psi coordinate.
The supplied radial pressure is nonnegative at sampled midplane radii and yields at least four strictly increasing flux samples up to its first exact zero.
plasma_mask=True suppresses the pressure derivative in that cell; it does not mark an included plasma region.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.description: Cylindrical radius at each field cell.
inputs.constraints: Uniform strictly monotone R axis in either storage direction; rectilinear grid and same shape as z_grid and psi_vac; at least two points per axis.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.description: Axial coordinate at each field cell.
inputs.constraints: Uniform strictly monotone Z axis in either storage direction; one complete exact Z=0 row.

inputs.name: pressure_of_radius
inputs.description: Midplane radial pressure function called at sampled R values.
inputs.constraints: Returns finite nonnegative scalar values; one sampled value must be exactly zero and the preceding flux samples must support a cubic spline.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.description: Caller-supplied vacuum or external psi=R A_phi, copied into the initial state.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grids and aligned with Green-matrix field-point rows in C order.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.description: Dense response from cell currents to field-point psi=R A_phi.
inputs.constraints: Rows and columns follow [Z,R] C-order field points and current cells; not a coil-to-probe cache.

inputs.name: tol
inputs.description: Threshold for both normalized flux-update and pressure-current closure residuals.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; no-update residuals remain +inf.

inputs.name: maxiter
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative; zero skips the update but still constructs and validates the initial pressure state.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.description: Weight of the previous cell current in the current update.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= relax < 1; zero uses only the current target; relax=1 is rejected because it freezes zero initial currents.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Cells whose pressure derivative is set to zero before current assembly.
inputs.constraints: Actual boolean array of the same shape as the grid; True suppresses the local derivative; numeric masks are rejected.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: Final psi=R A_phi, or an independent copy of psi_vac when no step runs.
outputs.constraints: Last evaluated flux state; no guarantee of convergence.

outputs.name: plasma_currents
outputs.description: Last cell-current state, zero before the first update.
outputs.constraints: One value per grid cell in [Z,R] order.

outputs.name: pressure_of_psi
outputs.description: Final pressure-flux samples and cubic-spline representation.
outputs.dtype: mapping of arrays, integer degree and strings, or None
outputs.constraints: Exactly the fitted prefix samples, knots, coefficients, degree and zero-extrapolation metadata; None when no valid terminal spline is available.

outputs.name: iterations
outputs.description: Number of attempted Picard updates; initial validation can terminate at zero.

outputs.name: residual
outputs.description: Last normalized L2 flux-change residual; +inf before any update.
outputs.constraints: Convergence requires this and closure_residual finite and <=tol; nonfinite states are explicitly marked.

outputs.name: residual_history
outputs.description: Flux residuals after completed paired residual evaluations.
outputs.constraints: N_completed<=iterations; an invalid attempted update may terminate before appending; no initial sentinel.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: Whether the shared solver achieved both finite residual thresholds after an update.
outputs.constraints: False for maxiter=0 at every tol and for every nonfinite terminal state.

outputs.name: failure_reason
outputs.description: Explicit failure marker or null on convergence.
outputs.constraints: None on convergence; maxiter_reached at the bound; specific solver reason for nonfinite/invalid terminal state.

outputs.name: closure_residual
outputs.constraints: Common component scaling preserves the target-norm definition; +inf before any update.

outputs.name: closure_residual_history
outputs.description: Closure residuals at the same evaluated states as residual_history.
outputs.constraints: Same length and ordering as residual_history.

preconditions: All arrays and controls satisfy the declared shapes and finite-value constraints.
The exact midplane pressure profile and flux samples meet the pressure-state Operator's spline conditions.
A nonzero psi_edge is required when at least one Picard step runs.
supported: Bounded pressure-only feedback with increasing or decreasing uniform coordinate storage, final closure gates and explicit terminal state.
excluded: Nonuniform or unstructured grids and non-axisymmetric geometry.
Guarantees that a finite iteration bound will converge or that the caller's pressure and Green matrix are physically suitable.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid finite-array, grid, callback, control or boolean-mask contracts; supplied pressure samples must be finite nonnegative scalars.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: The shared solver returns status=nonfinite for invalid computed derivative/current/Green/fit/residual with a specific reason. Invalid inputs and pressure callback exceptions propagate without fallback.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: status=maxiter, converged=False and failure_reason=maxiter_reached when the bound is reached before both residual gates. With maxiter=0 both residuals remain +inf.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Failed results retain the available terminal state and histories; pressure_of_psi is None if no valid spline exists. A failed Green update retains the preceding finite flux/current pair. No partial state is accepted as a solution.

example.description: With a zero Green response, one update leaves the vacuum flux unchanged while constructing a pressure spline.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium import solve_isotropic_pressure_flux
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, 4), [-0.1, 0.0, 0.1])
result = solve_isotropic_pressure_flux(r_grid=r_grid, z_grid=z_grid, pressure_of_radius=lambda r: max(1.0-r/0.8, 0.0), psi_vac=r_grid.copy(), g_psi=np.zeros((12, 12)), tol=1e-12, maxiter=1, relax=0.0)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['psi'], r_grid)
assert result['iterations'] == 1 and result['converged']
assert result['pressure_of_psi']['extrapolation'] == 'zeros'
assert result['closure_residual']<=1e-12 and result['status']=='converged'
example.expected: One converged update, unchanged vacuum flux, a [3,4] current array and a zero-extrapolating pressure-spline representation.

scope: A one-cell current generated by the real graph produces the selected off-source circular-filament psi=R A_phi increment without a 2*pi factor.
Wrong Green shape, missing controls, nonuniform grid and fractional maxiter failures.
Zero-iteration return owns an independent flux array.
Zero-G relaxed-current and no-update false convergence are rejected.
Independent nonzero diagonal-G analytic fixed point and both residual histories agree with the quadratic defining equation.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Targeted source regressions, explicit analytic fixtures and a selected no-source installed-wheel replay cover this finite contract. No arbitrary physical-model suitability, continuum convergence, human scientific endorsement or redistribution permission is inferred.
known_limitations: Uses a dense square Green matrix and a pressure spline defined by an exact midplane and exact zero-pressure sample.
No adaptive damping or physical-model selection is performed.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.

execution.ordering: Validate inputs; call the single shared bounded solver; serialize a valid terminal pressure prefix; return explicit status and histories.
branches: maxiter=0 returns unsolved state with both residuals +inf.
Invalid computed state returns nonfinite; convergence requires both finite residuals <=tol.
execution.state_ownership: Only compute_equilibrium owns evolving flux/current state and paired histories. The adapter adds no feedback loop.
execution.failure_propagation: Input/callback exceptions propagate; failed numerical terminal states remain explicit data.

feedback.state: psi, currents, pressure spline, paired residuals and iteration count internal to compute_equilibrium
feedback.initialization: Copy vacuum flux, zero current, both residuals +inf, empty histories.
feedback.update_order: Pressure derivative and target; current relaxation; Green flux; terminal fit; flux and closure residuals.
feedback.continue_when: Either residual exceeds tol and finite state remains and count<maxiter.
feedback.stop_when: Both finite residuals <=tol, invalid state, or maxiter.
feedback.nonconvergence: Explicit maxiter/nonfinite status; never silently accepted.
